maddeler.e:
نستهدم (form X)
# نَسْتَهْدِمُ (nastahdimu) /nas.tah.di.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# نَسْتَهْدِمَ (nastahdima) /nas.tah.di.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
# نَسْتَهْدِمْ (nastahdim) /nas.tah.dim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْدَمَ (istahdama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
